blocks.text:
This section contains the entire Help section as listed in the in-game Command Menu, word for word.

- Operation (search HELP-1)
- System (search HELP-2)
- Battle (search HELP-3)
- Command (search HELP-4)
- Menu (search HELP-5)
- FAQ (search HELP-6)

blocks.title: Operation (HELP-1)
blocks.text:
**Walk / Run**

Use the directional buttons or the left analog stick to move your character.

Press down the CROSS button while moving the character with the directional buttons or the left analog stick to run.

**Talking and Examining**

Stand in front of the person you want to talk to, or object you want to examine, and press the CROSS button.

You can't examine objects without a symbol prompt.

**Picking Up Objects**

While exploring the submap, the "?" icon may appear over a character's head.

Press the CROSS button to pick up the object.

**Opening Treasure Chests**

Certain areas of the submap contain treasure chests. Stand in front of the chest and use the CROSS button to open it up.

There aren't any monsters hiding in the chests, so be sure to check all of them!

**Opening the Menu**

Press the SQUARE button on the submap or World Map to open the menu. You can use items and change equipment on the menu screen. You can't open the menu during an event or battle.

Please read the "Menu" section for more details.

**Saving / Loading**

Open the menu and select "Data" to save or load data.

You can only save your game on Save Points (glowing pentagrams) in the submap, or World Map. You can't select "Save" elsewhere.

You can load data from the menu screen at any time.

You can create up to 20 save data.

To "Save" or "Load", select the desired file with the up and down directional buttons.

blocks.title: System (HELP-2)
blocks.text:
**Judgment Ring**

The Judgment Ring decides your fate in battles, events, and shops.

The Judgment Ring consists of a bar that swings around the ring and specific areas set within the ring.

Rings combining many variations of these two elements appear in the game.

**World Map**

This map shows all of the places you've visited. It also displays cities and locations you can move through, and you can decide where to go next.

You can also open the menu to save data or change equipment.

**Submap**

Fields where you control the characters and talk to people, see events, and move the story forward are called submaps.

There are also World Maps that move you from town to town, and battlefields where you fight enemies.

**Entering Name**

When a new character joins you, you can enter a name of your choice on the name entry screen. Be creative!

Note: you can't change a character's name once you exit the name entry screen.

Directional buttons - Move cursor CROSS button - Enter/confirm letter TRIANGLE button - Delete 1 letter START button - confirm name CIRCLE button - Return to default SQUARE button - Delete entered name L1 / R1 buttons - Change name entering position

**Game Over**

The game is over if all members in your party become immobilized (HP 0 or Petrified) in battle.

To continue, reload your save data or start over from the beginning.

Battles can be cruel. Save frequently to avoid repeating the same section over and over again.

**Graveyard**

A creepy graveyard that used to appear in the main character's nightmares. It became more prominent in his mind when he met the heroine.

You can acquire the souls of Fusion Monsters and clear out accumulated Malice by fighting here.

**Entering the Graveyard**

To enter the Graveyard, use a Save Point on a submap, or open the menu while in World Map and choose "Graveyard".

**Malice**

Malice is the vengeance of monsters you've killed.

Malice accumulates every time you kill a monster. When the Malice meter reaches maximum capacity, the door to the dark side opens wide and calls the Grim Reaper to the real world.

**Grim Reaper**

A menacing entity that materializes into the real world from the graveyard when enough Malice accumulates.

When the talisman turns blood-red, and Malice has reached maximum capacity, the Grim Reaper can appear anywhere.

If the Grim Reaper appears in battle, the main character must fight him one-on- one. Even if he wins the battle, the Grim Reaper returns until Malice is cleared out.

To avoid battles with the Grim Reaper, clear out the accumulated Malice before it reaches maximum capacity.

**Talisman**

The talisman on the lower-right corner of the menu displays the accumulation of Malice. As Malice accumulates, the talisman changes its color from blue to green, green to yellow, and yellow to red.

When the Malic capacity goes up a level, a close up of the talisman appears at the end of battle and shows the current color.

**Clearing Out Malice**

Enter the graveyard to clear out any accumulation of Malice. At the graveyard, the Four Masks will turn the accumulated Malice into a monster. Once you defeat it, Malice clears out and the talisman turns blue.

Malice can turn into 4 different levels of monsters, depending on how much Malice has accumulated. When the Malice level is high, the monster is very strong.

**Soul Energy**

You gain Soul Energy for a specific Class when you defeat an enemy. Soul Energy is sent to the graveyard according to its Class. When enough Soul Energy accumulates in a grave, the seal on the tombstone begins to glow. When this happens, the monster inside the tombstone is ready to fight as a fusion monster.

See the Soul Energy screen after battle or choose "Graveyard" from the menu to see how much Soul Energy has accumulated.

**Acquiring A Fusion Soul**

When the Soul Energy accumulates, the seal on the tombstone for that Class begins to glow.

Examine the glowing tombstone to make the Fusion Monster appear.

If you win the battle, you can acquire its Soul as a Fusion Soul.

However, you must fulfill certain conditions in order to acquire any Fusion Souls above level 2.

**Shopping**

To purchase or sell items, weapons, and armor, enter a shop or talk to the people in town and locate a street vender. Be sure to check back in these shops after a major event.

Their inventory may have changed!

Note: you can't sell any weapon, armor, or accessory that is equipped on a party member.

**Discount / Raise Price**

If you own a Guild Card, you can get a discount or raise the sale price of items in shops.

You start at 10% decrease or increase, but as you gain more Guild Cards, that number will also increase.

The Judgment Ring spins with every 10% discount and 5% raise price.

Press the CROSS button on all three yellow areas to pull off a discount or a raise price.

Note: Even if you succeed at a discount or raise price, failing an attempt afterwards will cancel the discount / increase, and you will be forced to buy / sell at the starting price.

**Acupuncturist**

Talk to Meiyuan to enter the "Acupuncturist" screen. He can increase the power of your weapon and / or widen hit areas.

Select a character and weapon to strengthen. The screen will switch to Level Settings. While placing the cursor on "Attack Power" and "Hit Area", use the left and right directional buttons to select from 3 levels of change.

If you raise a weapon's "Attack Power Level (A-Lv.)", its attack power increases, but the hit area narrows.

The changes in cost, attack power, and hit area are displayed in real-time as you make your adjustments. If you are satisfied with the stats, select "OK" to start a session.

To return your weapon to default stats after a session, choose "Reset". You won't get your money back, though!

**Party Formation**

You must choose party members when you gain more than 3 party characters.

Certain events force you to form a party. At other times, talk to Meiyuan to make changes.

Depending on the situation, however, some characters can't join the party.

Those characters are indicated in grey, and you can't select them.

**Lottery**

The Lottery is sponsored by the "Worldwide Lottery Association".

Members are scattered around the world, and you can try your luck if you have a ticket. One ticket equals one drawing.

The members of the Lottery Association only reveal themselves if you own a lottery ticket.

When you start a lottery, the Judgment Ring appears at the lower-right corner of the screen and the bar begins to spin. When you hit the CROSS button, the bar begins to slow down.

It the bar stops in one of the colored areas, you will receive a prize according to its color. Only one member can receive the 1st prize, which is the red area.

**Pit Fight**

A special fighting area where you can battle against Mr. Zhen's monsters.

Choose a member from your party and win 10 battles. How much prize money you receive depends on the number of consecutive wins.

You can enter the pit fight as many times as you want with the admission fee of 300 cash.

**Pit Fight 2**

Could it be her leader's influence? Sharon now summons monsters for Old Carl's pit fight arena.

She can only summon once in the beginning, but she will be able to summon more monsters as the game progresses.

If you win 10 times in a row, Sharon will give you a special gift.

Where did she get the gift? Well, you better ask Joshua...

blocks.title: Battle (HELP-3)
blocks.text:
**Starting Battle**

When you encounter enemies on the submap, the screen distorts and a battle begins.

**How To Fight**

You take turns with the enemy in battle. Select from Attack, Special Attack, Item, Defend, Flee, Front, or Back, and press the CROSS button.

Press Left for "Forward", press Right for "Back" and press R1 Button to "Run Away".

The Attack, Special Attack, and Item commands are activated by maneuvering the Judgment Ring successfully.

**Back Attack / Cross Attack**

The monsters you encounter may attack you from behind (Back Attack) or front and back (Cross Attack).

Enemies attack first in a Back Attack.

In a Cross Attack, you must clear out the enemy on one side in order to escape.

**Using the Judgment Ring During Battle**

You use the Judgment Ring to activate the following commands: Attack, Special Attack, and Item.

Select a command and target to display the ring. Hit all colored areas once with the CROSS button while the bar makes a full circle around the ring to pull off a command successfully.

**Critical Areas**

Certain zones behind the hit areas of the Judgment Ring are colored in red. These are called Critical Areas, and pressing the CROSS button in these areas increases the effectiveness of the chosen command.

Trying to hit Critical Areas may lead to Ring failure. Whether you take the risk and win beg rewards, or play it the standard way is up to you.

**Judgment Ring / Attack**

When you select the "Attack" command, the Judgment Ring appears.

There are 3 yellow areas on the ring. As the bar circles the ring, hit the CROSS button on the 3 colored areas. If your timing fails, or the bar makes a full rotation, your turn is over.

If you succeed once, you'll attack your enemy once, twice, or three times. If you fail, no strikes will be made against the target.

The 3 areas differ in placement and range depending on the character and weapon.

**Strike Hits**

"Strike Hits" occur randomly during a normal attack.

Attacks with Strike Hits inflict 1.5 times more damage than normal attacks.

**Judgment Ring / Item**

If you select the "Item" command, the item to be used and its target, the Judgment Ring appears.

One area of the ring is colored in blue. As the bar passes by the blue area, hit the CROSS button.

If you succeed, you can use the item.

When you fail to complete the Ring, no item will be used and your inventory won't be affected.

**Doubling Up On Items**

Certain items raise a character's attack power, or slow down the rotation speed of the bar.

If these items are used within an effective turn, you can combine the effects of a couple of items.

For instance, if you use a "Silver Hourglass" and a "Bronze Arrowhead" simultaneously, you can slow down the rotation speed of the bar AND double the Ring's hit area.

However, if you use double up on the same item, such as using 2 "Bronze Arrowheads", the effect does not go over or under the top and bottom limits.

The effect of the items are nullified once the turn is over.

The top and bottom limits of each effect is as follows.

- Bar Rotation Speed / Area: Tops out at double the regular value, and bottoms out at half.
- Tops out at 3 times the regular value.
- Raising Atk, Def, and Eva through Special Skill: Tops out at 30% increase.

**Judgment Ring / Special Skill**

When you select a Special Skill command and its target, the Judgment Ring appears. Depending on the skill, the Ring may or may not have a "Step Area".

Hit the CROSS button in the indicated areas to activate the skill.

**Step Areas**

Step areas are 1-4 strips of green on the Judgment Ring that lead to the hit areas when using a Special Skill.

Press the CROSS button as the bar passes the step areas to activate the skill.

You must enter all step areas for the command to succeed.

**Modulation Areas**

Modulation areas are colored in a gradation from white to green.

The effectiveness of your skill is modulated, depending on where you hit the CROSS button within these areas.

Hit the CROSS button near the very end of the modulation areas to get the maximum effect.

When you hit the CROSS button too quickly in the modulation areas, "HIT" is displayed and the skill activates, but not at its full potential.

To get the maximum effect, try to hit the CROSS button as close to the modulation areas as possible.

"GOOD" or "PERFECT" is displayed for successful modulation areas hits.

**Front / Back Row**

The party splits into front and back rows during battle. Front row members' attacks are more powerful, but they receive more damage. The opposite is true for the back row.

Use the "Formation" command in the menu to pre-set your front / back row formation.

To switch a member between front / back row during battle, press the left or right directional button during command entry and press the CROSS button while "Front" or "Back" are on display.

**HP / MP**

HP represents character' hit points. When a character's HP reaches 0, that character is immobilized. MP represents magic points. They decrease when you use magic.

The maximum level of both points goes up as characters develop. Recover any loss by resting at an inn or using recovery items and abilities.

**SP**

SP represents sanity points. Battles can wear out the sanity of the most seasoned fighter. You lose 1 SP with each turn.

When SP reaches 0, that character loses control, goes "berserk", and you cannot control him / her.

**Berserk**

When a character's SP falls below 0, he or she goes Berserk and cannot be controlled. Berserked characters don't gain EXP at the end of battles, and he or she may attack allies and use items excessively.

To remove Berserk, use items that recover SP, or end battle.

**Class**

All character have their own "Class".

They are:

Light, Darkness, Earth, Water, Fire, Wind, and non-class.

The following combinations oppose each other:

Fire / Water, Earth / Wind, and Darkness / Light.

Try to take advantage of the opposing combos. Using water attacks on a Water enemy is less effective, while using Fire attacks on the same enemy increases the effect of the attack. Non-class and other Class that are not the same or opposite of the enemy's class don't affect the amount of damage.

Determine the enemy's Class and use the Class system to your advantage.

**Status Abnormalities**

Some monsters cause status abnormalities like "Poison" and "Confusion".

To remove status abnormalities, use the appropriate items or special skills.

All status abnormalities are removed when the battle ends.

**Status Abnormality / Poison**

A character afflicted by Poison receives damage each time his or her turn comes around.

To remove Poison, use items like Mermaid's Tear, or Special Skill that cures poison.

**Status Abnormality / Silence**

A character afflicted with Silence can't use any Special Skills.

Silence removes itself automatically after a certain number of turns.

To remove it immediately, use items like Faerie's Sigh, or Special Skill that cures Silence.

**Status Abnormality / Paralysis**

A character afflicted with Paralysis can only use items or defend against attacks.

Paralysis removes itself automatically after a certain number of turns.

To remove it immediately, use items like Angel's Feather, or Special Skill that cures Paralysis.

**Status Abnormality / Confusion**

A character afflicted with Confusion loses control, attacks enemy and allies indiscriminately, and uses items excessively.

If the inflicted character receives damage, Confusion is removed. You can also use items like Holy Mother Bust, or Special Skill that cures Confusion.

**Status Abnormality / Petrification**

A character afflicted with Petrification loses turns and loses all command functions.

To remove Petrification, use items like Imp's Fangs, or Special Skill that cures Petrification.

**Status Abnormality / Instant Death**

A character afflicted with Instant Death loses all HP and becomes immobilized.

You can remove Instant Death the same way you revive characters that have become immobilized under usual circumstances.

**Status Abnormality / Knockback**

Knockback occurs as an additional effect of Special Skill.

Knockback attacks blow a front row member to the back row.

Nothing happens if a back row member receives a Knockback.

**Judgment Ring Abnormality / Narrow**

When a Narrow Judgment Ring is inflicted, the Hit Areas decrease by half.

Narrow removes itself automatically after a certain number of turns.

To remove it immediately, use items like Phoenix Tail, or Special Skill that cures Judgment Ring Abnormalities.

**Judgment Ring Abnormality / Haste**

When Haste is inflicted, the bar that circles the Judgment Ring accelerates to twice the normal speed.

Haste removes itself automatically after a certain number of turns.

To remove it immediately, use items like Phoenix Tail, or Special Skill that cures Judgment Ring Abnormalities.

**Judgment Ring Abnormality / Shrink**

When inflicted with Shrink, the Judgment Ring shrinks in size.

Shrink removes itself automatically after a certain number of turns.

To remove it immediately, use items like Phoenix Tail, or Special Skill that cures Judgment Ring Abnormalities.

**Judgment Ring Abnormality / Irregular Speed**

When inflicted with Irregular Speed, the bar that circles the Judgment Ring changes its speed at random.

Irregular Speed removes itself automatically after a certain number of turns.

To remove it immediately, use items like Phoenix Tail, or Special Skill that cures Judgment Ring Abnormalities.

**Judgment Ring Abnormality / Blind Ring**

A character afflicted with Blind Ring can't see the Hit Areas on the Judgment Ring.

Blind Ring removes itself automatically after a certain number of turns.

To remove it immediately, use items like Phoenix Tail, or Special Skill that cures Judgment Ring Abnormalities.

**Ending A Battle**

Defeat all the enemies to end the battle. ("Flee" and "Annihilated" do not apply to this rule.)

When a battle ends, the screen displays Experience Points, money, items you earned, and each character's Level-up status.

If you own any talisman, the screen also displays the acquired Soul Energy status.

If a seal is shining, it means that you've gained the required Soul Energy for that Class in the battle you've just fought.

**Raising Characters**

When you win a battle, each character gains Experience Points (EXP).

Accumulation of EXP is essential to raising each character's Level.

Any characters that are "Unconscious" or "Berserk" when the battle ends will not earn any EXP.

blocks.title: Command (HELP-4)
blocks.text:
**Attacks**

Attacks with weapons against a target.

Select the "Attack" command and choose a target to display the Judgment Ring on the top-right corner of the screen.

Press the CROSS button at the 3 Hit Areas. The number of successful presses in the Hit Area equals the number of hits against the target.

**Special Skill / Fusion**

The main character's Harmonixer ability enables him to fuse his body with the souls of monsters.

Select "Fusion" to see a list of Fusion Monsters acquired. You expend SP indicated next to the monster name when you fuse.

After fusing, "Fusion" becomes "Special Attack", and enables you to use the Fusion Monster's Special Attacks. You must have the required MP to pull off a Special Attack.

The main character is Darkness Class, but his class changes to the fusion monster's Class when fusing.

**Special Skill / White Magic**

The heroine's holy power. It heals party members and punishes evil.

Select "White Magic" to see a list of magic you can use. The number next to each magic is the MP required. Select a magic and maneuver the Judgment Ring to activate it.

**Special Skill / Yin and Yang**

Special skill of an oracle called Absolute Sage. Heals and summons monsters.

Select "Yin and Yang" to see a list of magic you can use. The number next to each magic is the MP required. Select a magic and maneuver the Judgment Ring to activate it.

**Special Skill / Secret Weapon**

A series of highly advanced technologies used by an elite spy, Malkovich. She uses her cell phone to call in an attack.

Select "Secret Weapon" to see a list of weapons you can use. Select a weapon and maneuver the Judgment Ring to activate it. The number next to each magic is the MP required.

**Special Skill / Ritual**

Special skill that uses vampire rituals passed down for generations of Valentines.

Select "Ritual" to see a list of rituals you can perform. Select a ritual, and maneuver the Judgment Ring to activate it. The number next to each magic is the MP required.

**Special Skill / ESP**

Special Skill of the London Rats' leader. He possessed this horrible ability since birth.

Select "ESP" to see a list of skills you can perform. Select a skill, and maneuver the Judgment Ring to activate it. The number next to each magic is the MP required.

**Using Items**

Expend a turn to use an item. You must pull off the Judgment Ring successfully for the item to take effect.

**Defend**

Guard against physical and special attacks from the enemy to reduce damage.

This command doesn't require the use of the Judgment Ring.

**Flee From Battle**

From the Battle Command menu, press the R1 button or the L1 button to prompt the "Flee" command.

Press the CROSS button to escape from battle.

Be warned that this may not work under certain circumstances.

**Moving Forward / Back During Battle**

From the Battle Command menu, press left or right on the directional buttons to prompt the "Front" or "Back" commands.

Press the CROSS button while either command is on display to activate it.

Note that front row members can't select "Front" and back row members can't select "Back".

blocks.title: Menu (HELP-5)
blocks.text:
**Items**

Select to see list of items in inventory. To use an item, select "Use and choose the item you want to use.

Select "Sort" to change the order of items on the screen.

Select "Discard" to throw out selected items.

**Special Skill**

Displays each character's Special Skills learned thus far. If there is a skill that recovers HP, you may use it here in exchange for MP.

**Equipment / Description**

- [Weapon] - Weapon currently equipped. "A-Lv." is the weapons attack power level, and "H-Lv." is the weapon's Hit Area expansion level.
- [Armor] - Armor currently equipped.
- [Accessories] - Accessories currently equipped. You can equip up to 3.

Str. = Strength Vit. = Vitality Agl. = Agility Int. = Intelligence Pow. = Power Lck. = Luck

P-Atk. = Physical Attack Power S-Atk. = Special Attack Power P-Def. = Physical Attack Defense Power S-Def. = Special Skill Defense Power P-Hit. = Physical Attack Accuracy S-Hit. = Special Skill Accuracy P-Evd. = Physical Attack Evasion S-Evd. = Special Attack Evasion

**Equipment / Change**

Displays equipped weapon, armor, and accessories by character. Select "Change" to change equipment, and choose an item to replace it with. Consider how a character's stats will be affected when changing equipment.

**Equipment / Strongest**

"Strongest" automatically equips the strongest combinations of weapons, armor, and accessories to maximize a character's stats. The downside, however, is that strongest weapons have narrow Hit Areas, and some accessories make the Ring spin faster. Take these into consideration and make adjustments as necessary.

**Equipment / Soul**

The main character can equip up to 3 Souls for Fusion during battle. Select "Soul" and choose up to 3 Souls to equip.

Press the SQUARE button to read each Soul's description and its Special Skills.

**Equipment / Equipped Items**

Choose "Equipped Items" to see all weapons, armor, accessories, and Souls in the inventory.

Press the CROSS or SQUARE buttons to read the description of an equipment or Soul.

The number next to each Soul is the SP required, and the number next to each Special Skill name is the MP required.

**Graveyard**

Enter the main character's spiritual world, "Graveyard". Select "Graveyard" from the menu while in the World Map or at a Save Point.

To enter the graveyard, select "Yes" when the game asks you whether you want to enter the graveyard.

The graveyard version of the menu displays Soul Energy accumulated thus far. When Soul Energy reaches a certain point, a seal for that class begins to glow. Go to the graveyard to challenge the new Fusion Soul for acquisition after battle.

**Valuables**

Shows all valuables acquired thus far, even the ones you used along the way. Select a valuable and press the CROSS or SQUARE button to see an image and description of the object.

**Formation**

Assign battle formation (front or back) to each character. Select a character to change formation to see two options:

"Front (or Back)" and "Switch".

If the character is in the back, choose "Front" to change rows. Do the opposite for characters in front.

To change order, select "Switch" and choose the characters to switch the order.

The order doesn't affect battle damage given or received, but row placement does.

**Status**

Displays each character's parameters and equipment.

Use the up and down directional buttons to select a head, and the left and right directional buttons to scroll through characters.

The lower-right corner of the screen displays each character's Class.

**Status / Description 1**

- [Level] - Character's Level. Level shows a character's growth and strength.
- [Hit Points (HP)] - Character's hit points. The left is the current HP and the right is the maximum HP. Higher HP means a character is less prone to become Unconscious and able to take more hits.
- [Magic Points (MP)] - Character's magic points. The left is the current MP and the right is the maximum MP. Higher MP means a character can sustain more Special Skills.
- [Sanity Points (SP)] - Character's sanity. Higher SP means a character is less prone to go Berserk.

**Status / Description 2**

- [EXP (Experience Points)] - Character's experience points. Characters gain EXP by defeating monsters.
- [Next] - EXP required to reach the next Level. As characters go up in Level, so does the number of EXP required to level up.

**Status / Description 3**

- [Str. (Strength)] - Physical strength. Affects physical attack power.
- [Int. (Intelligence)] - Knowledge. Affects special attack power.
- [Vit. (Vitality)] - Stamina. Affects physical attack defense power.
- [Pow. (Power)] - Willpower. Affects special attack defense power.
- [Agl. (Agility)] - Reaction. Affects evasion, accuracy, and how quickly you get to a turn.
- [Lck. (Luck)] - Good luck. Good fortune is on your side!

**Help**

The message you're reading now is "Help". A new heading appears in "Help" when new elements are introduced in the game.

There will be a yellow "New" icon for new headings in the Help menu.

The controller button descriptions within Help is set to default.

They do not apply if you have changed the button settings in Config.

We hope this will help you with your journey!

**Data**

Use a Save Point on a submap or open the menu on World Map to save Shadow Hearts game data. You can load data wherever you can open the menu.

**Score**

See how many battles you've encountered, the Judgment Ring success rate, and other records of your journey.

Isn't it exciting to see your record? Go for the top rank!

**Library**

Read information on enemies and people you've encountered.

Switch between NPCs and Monsters with the up and down directional button, and scroll through characters / monsters with the right and left directional buttons.

Monsters get added to the library after you defeat them, not just encounter them.

**Option**

You can set basic control functions of the game here.

Select a heading with the up and down directional buttons, and choose setting with the left and right directional buttons.

- [Controller] - Select custom to go to the key customization screen. Set button configurations and choose "Confirm" to finish customization.
- [Sound] - Switch between Stereo and Mono.
- [Message Speed] - Switch message display speed between Fast and Slow.
- [Cursor Placement] - Select "Memory" to have the cursor memorize its last location. "Initialize" always displays the cursor at the top.
- [Vibration] - Set the vibration function ON or OFF.
- [Vibration Setting] - Switch the vibration function between Strong and Weak. This option doesn't work if the Vibration is OFF.

blocks.title: FAQ (HELP-6)
blocks.text:
**What Is A FAQ?**

FAQ is an abbreviation for Frequently Asked Questions.

This section provides many answers to the most commons questions. You may find the answers to your questions right here.

**Can't Attack Very Well**

The Judgment Ring may take some practice to get used to.

Try to focus on _hitting the button 3 times at the right timing_.

If you can pull off 3 hits in a row, you'll start to get the hang of it.

If it's still difficult, try some items that slow the bar rotation or widen the hit area. Explore different ways of making the Ring easier to deal with.

The most important thing is to keep practicing! The Judgment Ring is not too difficult. Try to devise your own strategy in mastering the Ring skill.

**Can't Save, Even With the Menu Open**

If you can't save, use a Save Point (a glowing pentagram) or open the menu in World Map.

Please go to the nearest Save Point.

**Can I Change Names?**

You can't change character names once you have named a character.

**Preventing Status Abnormalities**

It's best to avoid status abnormalities such as "Poison" and "Confusion".

Accessories can help you avoid status abnormalities. For example, a Shell Bracelet prevents Poison.

Also, remember that _"Instant Death" is a status abnormality_.

**Fox Face Is After Me**

Take a look at the talisman located at the lower-right corner of the menu screen. What used to be blue is now red, right? Malice is accumulated to the top limit.

When Malice accumulates to the limit, you encounter Fox Face. To avoid this, clear out the accumulated Malice in the graveyard.

To enter the graveyard, open the menu on a Save Point and select "Graveyard".

Talk to the Four Masks at the graveyard and fight a monster to clear out the Malice.

Please read the Help item titled "System" for more detail.

**Do Guild Cards Expire?**

There's no need for worry!

You can try for discounts and price raises as many times as you like. As long as you follow the _rules_, the cards won't expire.

What are the rules, you ask?

If you try for a discount and fail, but don't have enough money to buy the planned quantity, there will be a penalty of 1 point. If you accumulate 5 points, you will lose a card. Be careful!

**How Do I Use "????"?**

If you've just acquired a high-level fusion monster, some of its Special Skills may be displayed as "????" and can't be used.

To activate the "????" skills, you must release the subconscious within the Soul and fuse your body and soul with it once again.

That means...

(JLS's note: ...you need to let your SP run down to 0 while fused. When this happens, Yuri will automatically cast and learn the "????" skill.)
